about: The second target's vocabulary: the PDL module types this target can build, each mapped to a struct in gad_kit.h. Port and parameter names are PDL's own, so the same PDL resolves here and in VCV Rack. Curves are read from VCV Fundamental's source; see each module's `follows`.

source.core: https://github.com/VCVRack/Rack (v2 branch): src/core/MIDI_CV.cpp, src/core/Audio.cpp, src/keyboard.cpp, read 2026-11-04

units: volts on every cable: 1 V/oct pitch, 10 V gates, ±5 V audio; the audio sink divides by 10 (Audio.cpp:267)

MIDI_CV.follows: Rack core MIDI_CV.cpp:70-96; keyboard.cpp (Z = C4, Q = C5, velocity 127)

AUDIO_8.follows: Rack core Audio.cpp:262-270 (sample = volts / 10; only Audio-2 normals IN1 to the right, so on Audio-8 IN1 alone plays left only)
